# Business operations, communications, risk and knowledge

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `operations`  
**Mission:** Keep the company running: process, approvals, communication, risk and knowledge continuity.

## Startup stage

The COO hat on a founder, a one-page approval matrix, a risk register and the memory ledger as the knowledge base.

## Agents operating in this department

`operations-lead`, `operations-analyst`, `coo-operations`

## Roles

### Business operations manager

Role id: `business-operations-manager`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Design and run the processes the company needs and no more. |
| Scope of responsibility | Operating cadence, approval matrix, process documentation, tooling. |
| Core activities | Define cadence and rituals; Maintain approval matrix; Document processes; Remove process that adds no value |
| Inputs | Strategy; Capacity; Incidents |
| Outputs and deliverables | Operating plan; Approval matrix; Process docs |
| Decisions it can make | Process within policy |
| Decisions requiring approval | Changes to approval limits |
| Collaborating roles | all departments |
| Reporting relationship | coo |
| KPIs | Decision latency; Process defects |
| Quality expectations | Every process has an owner and a reason |
| Tools and resources | Operating plan template |
| Common failure modes | Process theatre; Unclear approval paths |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Approval limits |
